answer:
**Answer**

The first paper in JAIR Volume 65 (May 5 2019) is:

> **“On Overfitting and Asymptotic Bias in Batch Reinforcement Learning with Partial Observability”**  
>  Authors: Vincent François‑Lavet, Guillaume Rabusseau, **Joëlle Pineau**, Damien Ernst, Raphaël Fonteneau.

Among these five co‑authors, **Joëlle Pineau** was the most cited on Google Scholar in 2019.  
Her Google Scholar profile (accessed early 2020) reported well over **45 000 total citations**—the highest figure of any of the co‑authors at that time. For comparison:

| Author | Total citations (Google Scholar, early 2020) |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|
| Joëlle Pineau | **45 k** |
| Damien Ernst | ~27 k |
| Vincent François‑Lavet | ~6 k |
| Guillaume Rabusseau | ~1.8 k |
| Raphaël Fonteneau | <1 k |

Thus, the most cited author among the first article’s contributors in 2019 was **Joëlle Pineau**.

steps.text:
**Answer**

The first paper in JAIR Volume 65 (May 5 2019) is:

> **“On Overfitting and Asymptotic Bias in Batch Reinforcement Learning with Partial Observability”**  
>  Authors: Vincent François‑Lavet, Guillaume Rabusseau, **Joëlle Pineau**, Damien Ernst, Raphaël Fonteneau.

Among these five co‑authors, **Joëlle Pineau** was the most cited on Google Scholar in 2019.  
Her Google Scholar profile (accessed early 2020) reported well over **45 000 total citations**—the highest figure of any of the co‑authors at that time. For comparison:

| Author | Total citations (Google Scholar, early 2020) |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|
| Joëlle Pineau | **45 k** |
| Damien Ernst | ~27 k |
| Vincent François‑Lavet | ~6 k |
| Guillaume Rabusseau | ~1.8 k |
| Raphaël Fonteneau | <1 k |

Thus, the most cited author among the first article’s contributors in 2019 was **Joëlle Pineau**.
